Other outlets link the speeches to the coming trilateral meeting with Trump and to Western sanctions.
Reports Putin's claim that Russia became Europe's largest economy despite sanctions, alongside a government growth forecast of 0.4%.
Notes Xi did not mention export controls, Nvidia or the U.S. directly.

summary.text: The APEC CEO Summit 2026 opened in Shenzhen, where Chinese President Xi Jinping called for openness, cooperation and stable supply chains in the Asia-Pacific. Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin criticised Western protectionism and sanctions ahead of a trilateral meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump.

conclusion.text: Coverage agrees that Xi spoke against protectionism at the Shenzhen summit ahead of a meeting with Trump. The West-bloc outlet frames it as veiled criticism of the US, while East-bloc outlets relay Xi's cooperation themes, Putin's sanctions remarks, and note Xi did not name the U.S. directly.
